follow-up time: Varied, up to 36-39 weeks corrected postmenstrual age
exposure: long-term ventilated infants (died between 36 and 39 weeks)
early controls (infants who had lived <12 h)
short-term ventilated infants (died between 23 and 29 weeks)
cohort: Extremely preterm infants at risk for BPD
finding: Both incipient and established neonatal lung injury, particularly in the context of antenatal infection/inflammation, is associated with upregulation of SDF-1 expression in the respiratory epithelium, suggesting a potential role for the CXCR4/SDF-1 axis in BPD pathogenesis.
